ai-dip-2026-10.statement: 1. CRWV premiums are rich after the drop: puts overprice CRWV's downside.

study.measures: whether the option premium is rich: 30-day implied volatility against what the name then realized over 30 days

verdict.call: Stand aside, the premium is fair, not rich: implied 93% sits at the 63rd pct of CRWV's own next-30-day outcomes, -0.6 vol pts over the mean.
verdict.why: premium-fit: today's 30-day implied against what the name then realized over 30 days, one year of its own tape.
verdict.falsifier: A premium-fit re-run on or after 2026-11-13 shows implied vol at or above the 50th pct and priced assignment odds above the historical.

ai-dip-2026-10.statement: 2a. Sell puts before the print: the pre-print premium is worth selling.

study.measures: whether a put sold now for the last expiry before the print is paid more than the odds it finished under its strike in the same weather

verdict.call: Fair, not rich: the $55.00 put expiring 2026-11-06 is priced at 20% odds of assignment; like-weather episodes finished under that strike 12% to 21% (raw and vol-scaled).
verdict.why: cycle-phase on 2026-10-16: the close at the last expiry before the print, 22 independent clusters (pooled history, exact); priced odds are the put's delta.
verdict.falsifier: The $54 11-06 put and the next 2 pre-print Δ0.20 puts all expire worthless, the first on 2026-11-06.

ai-dip-2026-10.statement: 8. How long the drop lasts: back above today's price in 3 to 6 months is the base case.

verdict.call: Back to entry is the base case: 67% of like-weather episodes closed back above $64.72 within 63 sessions (median 43), and 35% regained the old high within 126.
